hero.title: Driven by love, guided by purpose
hero.subtitle: For over 8 years we have walked alongside children with autism and Down syndrome, their families and the communities that support them — turning compassion into real, lasting change.

mission.label: Who we are
mission.title: A community built on empathy and dedication
mission.desc: Rain Children was born from the belief that every child, regardless of diagnosis, deserves a full and joyful life. We are a team of passionate volunteers, therapists and educators working together to make that belief a reality every single day.

v1.title: Unconditional love
v1.desc: Every decision we make is grounded in genuine care for the children and families we serve.

v2.title: Joy in every moment
v2.desc: We believe happiness is not a destination but a daily practice, and we cultivate it in everything we do.

v3.title: Inclusive community
v3.desc: We build spaces where every child feels welcomed, valued and celebrated for exactly who they are.

v4.title: Excellence in care
v4.desc: We continuously raise our standards to ensure the best possible outcomes for the children in our programs.

story.label: Our journey
story.title: How Rain Children came to be

m1.title: The beginning
m1.desc: A small group of volunteers started meeting weekly to support two families with autistic children — with nothing but heart and determination.

m2.title: First centre opened
m2.desc: We opened our dedicated activity centre in Chișinău, offering structured programs to 40 children from the start.

m3.title: National recognition
m3.desc: Rain Children received a national award for social impact, and our volunteer network grew to over 80 members across Moldova.

m4.title: Growing stronger
m4.desc: Today we support over 1 200 children annually through 6 specialised programs, with 150+ active volunteers and new partnerships forming every year.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Rain Children — our mission, programs and how you can get involved.
faq.q1: What is Rain Children and who does it help?
faq.a1: Rain Children is a volunteer organisation dedicated to supporting children with autism and Down syndrome. We provide therapeutic programs, educational activities and community events to help every child reach their full potential.
faq.q2: How can I become a volunteer?
faq.a2: Simply visit our Contact page and fill in the volunteer form. No special skills are required — just a willingness to give your time and compassion. We will reach out to schedule an introductory meeting.
faq.q3: Are your programs free for families?
faq.a3: Yes. All of our programs and services are provided free of charge to families. We are funded entirely through donations and grants, so every contribution goes directly to the children.
faq.q4: How can I donate and will I receive a receipt?
faq.a4: You can donate through our Donate page using a bank transfer or online payment. After each donation you will receive an official receipt that can be used for tax purposes.
faq.q5: Can organisations or schools partner with Rain Children?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We actively collaborate with schools, clinics and businesses. If you represent an organisation interested in partnering with us, please reach out via our Contact page and we will discuss the possibilities.
faq.q6: Where do your activities take place?
faq.a6: Our activities are held at our dedicated centre as well as partner schools and community spaces around the city. Check our Events page for the latest schedule and locations.
